name: Hang Kenh communal house
kicker: Seven-bay ironwood hall in Lê Chân
summary: Walk the seven-bay ironwood hall at Hàng Kênh and see the boat-shaped floor. The hall on Nguyễn Công Trứ dates to 1719 and was rebuilt from 1841 to 1850. Forty-two columns stand on lotus stones, and nearly 400 dragons cover the carved panels. The rear hall keeps Ngô Quyền, a small boat, and a piece of wood for the Bạch Đằng stakes. A fee and a gate hour are Check on arrival. This is not chùa Dư Hàng.
getThere: Nguyễn Công Trứ in Hàng Kênh. Minutes from the square are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The courtyard and the hall at đình Hàng Kênh
gettingThere: The hall is on Nguyễn Công Trứ, phường Hàng Kênh, quận Lê Chân. The grounds are about 6,000 m². Minutes from the opera square are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the opera square
legs.body: Ride or walk south into Lê Chân, to Nguyễn Công Trứ. The minutes are Check on arrival.
